blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A small fine-tuned parser that emits a well-formed but wrong tree fails silently: nothing downstream can tell. We ask whether the output format, a free design choice, controls how often this happens. On the PIZZA ordering benchmark we fine-tune two sub-billion models (Qwen3.5-0.8B and LFM2.5-350M) with LoRA on six lossless encodings of the same target tree, from 44.3 down to 10.9 tokens per order, including two matched-length pairs that vary surface form at fixed length. Across 300 runs (5 training pool sizes, 5 seeds) with a hierarchical bootstrap and Holm correction fixed before the results were read, shortening alone never helps, but writing the target in ordinary words does. The word encoding is the most accurate format on both models (87.5% vs. 85.8% exact match for the native s-expression on Qwen) while emitting 4.1x fewer tokens, and it cuts the silent error rate by 2.3x on Qwen and 1.8x on LFM2, separating at every pool size. Error analysis locates much of the gain in negation. All runs also learn to refuse off-menu input (held out: 95.9-99.0% handled) and to apply in-utterance self-corrections. Strict refusal has a measured price: 2.1-10.1% of real, mostly polite, orders are refused.
blocks.zh: 一个小的微调解析器, 释放出一棵造型良好但错误的树 沉默的失败: 任何下游都看不出来。 我们问产出格式,自由的设计选择,是否控制了这种情况的发生频率. 在PIZZA定购基准上,我们与LORA一起,对两个10亿级以下的模型(Qune3.5-0.8B和LFM2.5-350M)进行微调,对同一目标树的6个无损编码,从每枚44.3个降为10.9个令牌,包括两对在固定长度下不同表面形态的配对. 超过300个跑步(5个训练池大小,5个种子),在阅读结果前固定了分级的靴子和Holm校正,光是缩短就无济于事,但用普通的文字来写目标. 编码一词是两种模型中最准确的格式(87.5%对85.8%准确匹配Quen上的原生s-表达),同时释放4.1x更少的符号,它将Quen上的无声误差率减少2.3x,LFM2上的1.8x,在每个池大小上分离. 错误分析查找否定中的大部分收益 。 所有运行还学会拒绝非菜单输入(持有量:95.9%-99.0%处理),并应用非菜单自修. 严格拒绝有量价:2.1%-10.1%的真实,多为礼貌的订单被拒绝.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Small language models are attractive for narrow parsing tasks: they fine-tune in
minutes, run on a laptop or a tablet, and cost almost nothing per call. Their
weakness is reliability ( Ji et al., 2023 ) , and in structured prediction an
error comes in two kinds. An output that does not parse, or that the model marks
as a refusal, is detectable : the caller rejects it and asks again. An
output that parses into a plausible tree that is not what the customer said is silent : the order goes through, wrong. This paper treats the silent error
rate S S as the quantity a deployment should minimise, and reports exact match A A beside it for comparison with prior work (Section 5 ).

几分钟后,用笔记本电脑或平板电脑运行,每通电话几乎一文不值。 他们的
弱点是可靠性(Ji等人,2023年),在结构化预测中,
错误分为两种。 不解析或模型标记的输出
以拒绝方式, 一个
输出到一棵假树上, 命令通过,错误。 本文处理沉默错误
将S作为部署应尽量减少的数量,并报告与AA完全吻合,以便与以前的工作进行比较(第5节)。

blocks.en:
The work began with a deployed café ordering parser whose compact output format
was chosen for speed; its small hand-written test set could not tell formats
apart, so we moved to a public benchmark with a human-written test set.
Our question is whether the target format is itself a lever on silent errors.
The same tree can be written as an s-expression, as JSON, as key=value pairs, as a terse symbolic language or as plain words, and the choice changes how
many tokens the model emits and how much of its pretraining it can reuse. The
intuitive hypothesis, that fewer output tokens leave less room for error, turns
out to be wrong in the form we first stated it. Shortening helps only when the
surface stays in natural words.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
That the meaning representation affects a parser is long established: Dong and Lapata (2016) decode logical forms as trees rather than sequences, and
seq2seq parsers for task-oriented dialogue generate the target directly ( Rongali et al., 2020 ) . Closest to us, Shin et al. (2021) show that a frozen language model
prompted to produce a canonical natural-language form, mapped to the
representation by a grammar, beats prompting for the representation itself. We
find the same phenomenon under fine-tuning, where the model is free to learn any
notation, and we separate naturalness from length with matched pairs and two
vocabularies.
blocks.zh:
影响表述的意义早已确立: 董和拉帕塔(2016年)将逻辑形式解码为树而非序列,以及
用于面向任务的对话的以下2seq分析器直接生成目标(Rongali等人,2020年)。 最贴近我们,申等人(2021年) 显示一个冷冻的语言模型
被催生出一种古老的自然语言形式
以语法表示代表,等于促使代表本身。 我们
在微调下发现同样的现象,其中模型可以自由学习任何
标注,我们把自然与长度分开 配对和两个
词典.

blocks.en:
Tam et al. (2024) find that forcing an LLM into JSON costs reasoning accuracy. Constrained
decoding makes invalid output impossible ( Scholak et al., 2021 ; Geng et al., 2023 ; Willard and Louf, 2023 ) ; it can
remove our unparseable outputs, but it cannot make a well-formed tree correct, so
the silent rate is the part of the problem it does not reach.
blocks.zh:
Tam等人(2024年)发现,强迫LLM进入JSON需要推理精度. 约束
(Scholak等人,2021年;Geng等人,2023年;Willard和Louf,2023年)
移除我们无法解析的输出, 但是它不能使一个良好形状的树正确, 所以
沉默率是它没有触及的问题的一部分。

blocks.en:
Knowing when not to answer has been studied for reading comprehension ( Rajpurkar et al., 2018 ) and under domain shift ( Kamath et al., 2020 ) . Spoken self-repair is a
classic topic in disfluency research ( Shriberg, 1994 ) , and Disfl-QA shows that
disfluent input breaks QA models ( Gupta et al., 2021 ) . Task-oriented parsing datasets
such as TOP, TOPv2 and MTOP ( Gupta et al., 2018 ; Chen et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2021 ) , and PIZZA itself, contain
neither off-domain refusals nor self-corrections; we add both as synthetic
training data and evaluate them on held-out vocabulary and cue phrases.

Disfl-QA指出,

blocks.en:
Subword segmentation ( Sennrich et al., 2016 ) sets what a string costs, and vocabulary fit moves
accuracy ( Rust et al., 2021 ) . We follow recommendations to report seed variance and
significance ( Dror et al., 2018 ; Bouthillier et al., 2021 ) , using a bootstrap ( Efron and Tibshirani, 1993 ) with Holm’s
correction ( Holm, 1979 ) .

3 Task and Data
blocks.zh: 3 任务和数据

blocks.en:
PIZZA ( Arkoudas et al., 2022 ) maps spoken pizza and drink orders to trees with an unordered
exact-match criterion. Its training pool of 2,456,446 utterances is
generated from a grammar; the 348-utterance development set and the
1,357-utterance test set are written by people, which makes the test set the
strongest evidence in this paper. The pool contains 3 rows identical
to a development or test utterance. We drop them from training, and verify on
every training subset we draw, at every size and seed, that no evaluation
utterance remains, exactly or after normalisation. The splits are used as
published.

blocks.en:
PIZZA has no notion of “not an order”: a model trained on it turns “hehe hehe” into a pizza. We add generated negatives making up
30% of every training set: chatter, off-menu requests, gibberish, long
text, and real orders with an off-menu clause or an unknown word inserted. The
rule is strict: anything that is not purely an order is refused whole. Each format
has one short refusal string that cannot parse as an order in that format
( ? for the three word-like formats, (REJECT ) , (R) and {"reject":true} for the others), so all formats train on identical inputs.
Vocabulary is split: the 614 evaluation negatives use words never seen in
training.
blocks.zh:
PIZZA没有“不是命令”的概念:训练有素的模特将“hehe hehe”变成披萨。 我们加入了生成的负数
每集培训的30%:闲聊、闲谈、胡言乱语、长篇
文本,并插入非菜单条款或未知单词。 那个
规则是严格的:任何并非纯粹的命令都会被完全拒绝。 每种格式
有一个简短的拒绝字符串不能以该格式解析命令
(?)对于三种类似字词的格式,(REJECT),(R)和{'reject': true}对于其他格式,所以所有格式都用相同的输入进行训练.
词汇被拆分:614评价负面使用从未见过的词
培训。

blocks.en:
PIZZA has no self-corrections either, so “a pizza with cheese, wait no
cheese, only tomato sauce” comes out with both cheese and no cheese. We take
real training orders, edit their tree, and append the spoken correction in nine
kinds (swap, retract, only, size, number, drink, cancel, restart, and decoys in
which a cue word changes nothing), adding 10% of the real orders. A
quarter of the cue phrases are held out: the 600 evaluation corrections are
test orders with held-out cues. A fixed set of 40 hand-written probes includes the
cheese example above, which a user reported against an earlier model. Dev and test
remain pure PIZZA, so A A and S S keep their meaning.

blocks.en: 4 Six Encodings of One Tree
blocks.zh: 4 条一树的六条编码

blocks.en:
Table 1: One test order, “i want a pie with pepperoni and extra cheese” , in the six encodings (long
targets truncated). Tokens are Qwen’s.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
Comparing unrelated formats confounds length with form, so we built six encodings
of the identical tree that decode back to it on every dev and test utterance
and on a 50,000-row training sample (Table 1 ). exr is the
dataset’s s-expression. json is a conventional encoding of about the same
length: the matched-length control for exr . exr-short renames exr ’s constructors to single letters. tagged is flat key=value pairs. dsl is a terse grammar with sigils ( + for an
extra quantity, ! for negation), and words has the same structure as dsl with the markers written as ordinary words; it is dsl ’s
matched-length control. exr , exr-short , tagged and dsl form a length ladder.

在那棵树上,每有一篇经文,每篇经文,每篇经文,都加以解密,
以及50 000人的培训样本(表1)。 Exr 是那个
数据集的表达式。 json是一个约相同的常规编码

额外数量, 用于否定), 单词结构与 dsl 相同, 标记为普通单词; 它是 dsl 的
匹配长度控制。 exr,exr-short ,标记和 dsl 组成一个长度阶梯.

blocks.en:
Over the 1,357 gold test trees, words is the longer of the matched
pair in characters (43.1 vs. 34.9) but costs fewer Qwen tokens
(10.3 vs. 10.8) and about the same number of LFM2 tokens (11.9
vs. 11.7; Appendix Table 7 ). Figure 1 shows why: +cheese splits into three subwords where extra cheese stays two.
Symbols save characters, not tokens. LFM2’s vocabulary is smaller and inflates
the punctuation-heavy formats most ( json 45.6 → \to 64.7 tokens, words 10.3 → \to 11.9).

blocks.zh: 5 设置和统计

blocks.en:
Qwen3.5-0.8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and LFM2.5-350M ( Amini et al., 2025 ) , a largely convolutional model with a
vocabulary about four times smaller. LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) with rank 16 and α = 16 \alpha{=}16 on all linear projections, batch 16, cosine schedule, loss on the
completion only. Rank is held fixed across formats because the comparison is
between formats, not adapters; Hu et al. (2022) found far lower ranks sufficient on
their tasks. Training runs to at most 4,000 steps (64,000 examples)
with early stopping every 100 steps (patience 10) on the mean of three dev
scores: exact match, refusal of dev negatives, and exact match on dev corrections.
The learning rate is chosen per model and format from { 10 − 4 , 2 ⋅ 10 − 4 , 5 ⋅ 10 − 4 } \{10^{-4},2{\cdot}10^{-4},5{\cdot}10^{-4}\} by dev exact match at a pool of 100k over 3 seeds,
then frozen (Appendix Table 8 ). The token cap per format is 1.25 times
its longest target, so no correct output can be truncated.

(Table 4 ). Chatter, gibberish and long text are refused essentially
always; the hardest kind is a real order with one unknown word, refused

Format barely matters here.

blocks.en:
2.1–5.4% of real test orders are refused on Qwen and
6.3–10.1% on LFM2. Reading them, they are genuine orders in
human phrasing the synthetic grammar never produces: greetings, thanks, and
stories ( “i’m having a bunch of people over tonight so i need five
pizzas…” ). Almost every refused order contains a word the training grammar never uses (96–100% on Qwen, 97–100% on LFM2), against 81% of the orders answered. An order with a greeting, please or thanks (289 of the test orders) is refused 6.1% of
the time by Qwen words against 2.6% for other orders. The
strict rule meets politeness the training grammar does not contain.

learned is the phrasing of the cue.

(Figure 5 ). Its lead over exr is largest at 1k
(+4.0 points on Qwen, +7.2 on LFM2) and narrows
with pool size; its lead over dsl does not narrow on Qwen
(+6.7 at 1k, +7.8 at the full pool). Natural words help

blocks.en: 6.6 Latency
blocks.zh: 6.6 延迟

blocks.en:
Median latency at batch size one is linear in output tokens (Qwen: 29 ms
+ 26.5 ms per token, R 2 = 1.00 R^{2}{=}1.00{} ; Appendix
Figure 6 ) with throughput flat across formats, so words answers 3.7 × \times faster than exr on Qwen and 4.4 × \times on LFM2. The process’s GPU memory moves only between 1,704 and
1,806 MiB on Qwen: format buys latency and accuracy, not memory.

+ 26.5毫秒/每令牌,R 2 = 1.00 R^{2}{=}1.00{};附录
图6),不同格式的吞吐量平坦,所以单词回答3.7×\时速快于Qwen的exr和LFM2的4.4×\时速. 进程的 GPU 内存在 1,704 和
1,806 MiB on Quen:格式购买耐久性和准确性,而不是内存.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en:
If a parser’s output is acted on without review, S S is the number that matters:
a format with higher A A but higher S S ships more wrong orders. A A is the right
number to compare with prior work, and D parse + D refuse D_{\text{parse}}+D_{\text{refuse}} is what a
retry or a human fallback has to absorb. On PIZZA the three point the same way for words , which need not hold elsewhere; reporting all four outcomes makes the
trade visible.
blocks.zh:
如果一个解析器的输出未经审查就被执行,SS就是重要的数字:
一种A级以上但S级以上航母更错误订单的格式。 A是权利
与先前工作比较的编号, D 解析 + D 拒绝 DQQQText{ parse{ DXXQText{ refuse} 是一个
复试或人背负必须吸收. 在PIZZA, 语句的三点相同,
贸易可见。

blocks.en:
The recipe is to compress the structure of the target and keep its vocabulary
natural. It costs nothing at inference, needs no new labels, and is measurable on
any parser with the four-way split. Whether the gap persists for larger models and
other tasks is open (Limitations).
blocks.zh:
秘方是压缩目标结构,保留其词汇
当然 推论不费钱,不需要新的标签,可以衡量
任何与四向分割的解析器。 差距是否继续存在于大型模型和
其他任务打开(限制)。

blocks.en:
Refusing anything that is not purely an order keeps the consumer from trusting
half a ticket, at the cost of 2.1–10.1% of real orders. A
softer rule, or negatives written in human rather than grammar style, could lower
that cost; we leave it to future work and report the strict rule’s price as is.
blocks.zh:
拒绝任何并非纯粹是命令的东西,使消费者无法信任
半张票,费用为实际订单的2.1-10.1%。 A级
较柔软的规则,或用人类而不是语法风格写成的负数,可以降低
我们把它留给今后的工作,并报告严格的规则的价格。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
Output format is a free design variable for a fine-tuned parser. On PIZZA, with two
model families, five pool sizes and five seeds, writing the target in plain words
matches or beats the native format’s accuracy with a quarter of the tokens and
roughly halves the errors nobody can detect, mostly by getting negation right. The
gain survives a refusal and self-correction guardrail trained into every run, and a
tokenizer under which the word form is the longer one.
blocks.zh:
输出格式是微调解析器的自由设计变量. 在PIZZA,有两个
模范家庭,5个池子大小和5个种子,用简单的字写目标
用四分之一的符号匹配或击败本地格式的精确度,
几乎把无人能察觉的错误减半,主要是通过正确否定。 那个
每跑一次都训练有素的 拒绝和自我矫正的护卫
标注器,其中单词形式是更长的。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
One dataset. All results are on PIZZA, whose training pool comes from a
grammar with a small vocabulary; the human-written test set is the main guard
against learning the grammar alone. Small models. Both models are under a
billion parameters; the effect may shrink with scale. Author-generated
guardrail data. Negatives, corrections and probes are generated or written by us,
and the human test set contains neither; 32 test orders (2.4%) use make it , make that or hold on in PIZZA’s own sense, which our
generator teaches as correction cues, bounding any effect on test exact match at
2.4 points. Every run includes the guardrail, so this campaign does not
measure what the guardrail costs in accuracy. Tuning. Three
learning rates were at the edge of the grid (Appendix Table 8 ); rank was
not tuned; 8 of 300 runs (all LFM2) reached their best checkpoint
within 100 steps of the step limit. Generation. 19 of
511,500 generations hit the token cap, all runaway outputs longer than any
correct ticket. Deployment. The exported LFM2 GGUF agrees with its trained
run on 93% of orders; no number in this paper comes from a GGUF.

语法有小词汇;人文测试集是主卫
反对独自学习语法。 小型模特儿 两个模型都处于

2.4点. 每跑步都包括护栏 所以这次运动不会
测量护栏的准确性。  Tu宁. 三个
学习率处于网格边缘(附录表8);
未调音;300次运行中有8次(均为LFM2)到达最佳检查站
在步限的100步内。 历代. 页:1

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
PIZZA is released under CC-BY-NC-4.0 and contains no personal data; we
redistribute no dataset text. All runs used two NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada GPUs.
A parser that refuses real orders shifts work to staff or customers; we report
that rate rather than hide it.

PIZZA在CC-BY-NC-4.0下发布,没有个人数据;我们
不重新分配数据集文本。 所有运行都使用了两个NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada GPU.
拒绝实际订单的分析员将工作转给工作人员或客户;我们报告
而不是藏起来

blocks.en: Appendix B Integrity Checks
blocks.zh: 附录B 检查

blocks.en:
Before reading any result we checked: all 300 runs complete; exact match and
parse validity recomputed from the raw outputs with the dataset’s matcher equal
the stored values in every run; negatives and corrections identical across
models, formats and sizes for a seed; no evaluation utterance in any training
subset; batched and batch-one generation agree on all but at most 2 of 200
utterances per run; left padding in every run. The analysis code and the checks
are in https://github.com/UmarGit/coffee-llm .
blocks.zh:
在读到任何结果之前,我们检查了:全部300个运行完成;精确匹配和
用数据集的匹配器从原始输出中校验出的有效性
每次运行中存储的数值; 负数和修正数相同
种子的模型、格式和大小;任何培训中都没有评价意见
子集; 批量和批量一代商定200人中除最多2人以外的全部
每跑一次的语句;每跑一次的左补丁. 分析代码和检查
https://github.com/UmarGit/coffee-llm。

blocks.en: Appendix C Deployment Demonstration
blocks.zh: 附录C 部署 示威

blocks.en:
The café parser that motivated this work, a separate model with its own compact
format, runs entirely on an iPad (iPad15,7, A16) through llama.cpp with Metal
offload: Q8_0 weights (795 MiB file, 350 MiB resident), 2.5 s load time,
median 167 ms and p90 354 ms per order, 16 tok/s. Latency on the
device is close to linear in output tokens, so the token savings of a compact
format translate directly into response time. This is a demonstration on ten
orders, not an evaluation.
blocks.zh:
推动这项工作的咖啡馆, 一个单独的模型 与自己的契约
格式,完全运行在iPad上(iPad15,7,A16),通过lama.cpp与Metal
卸载:Q8_0重量(795 MiB文件,350 MiB居民),2.5s载荷时间,
中位数167毫秒,每订单p90 354毫秒,16吨/秒. 时间紧迫
设备在输出符中接近线性,所以一个紧凑的符节
格式直接转换成响应时间。 这是十点的演示
命令,不是评估。
